originality.rationale: The exact all-height rank, boundary exceptions and ultraproduct criterion were compared against Walker 2022 full online HTML, Guingona et al. 2021 full HTML, Dovgoshey–Kostikov 2023 full HTML, and the Avdiukhin et al. 2023 abstract, plus published published-finding corpus semantic records. None of those inspected statements identifies this binary-mistake-tree rank for the class of descendant-leaf cylinders queried by leaves. This is a best-knowledge assessment, not an assertion that equivalent priority is impossible.

value.rationale: This gives a complete sharp online mistake bound for a natural family of all ultrametric balls (independent of branching except one boundary) with unbounded online/static separation and an exact stable-to-unstable transition for the corresponding model-theoretic incidence formula. The exact invariant is motivated by hierarchical membership learning, not arbitrary small parameter choice.
